hlg_98d6ce34de840fb6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable suppliers to register their accounts, submit product proposals with detailed specifications, and resubmit revised proposals within a defined timeframe in response to administrative feedback.
hlg_98d6ce34de840fb6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables supplier account registration with basic company details; llg_002 enables submission of a product proposal including SKU, description, pricing, and images; llg_003 enables resubmission of revised proposals within 5 working days after feedback, which introduces a time-bound revision workflow distinct from initial submission.

hlg_3ce73c4fcbf6e912_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: The system enables administrators to review and assign statuses to supplier proposals, while automatically rejecting proposals that exceed their evaluation deadlines.
hlg_3ce73c4fcbf6e912_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for administrators to manually evaluate proposals and assign statuses such as pending, approved, or rejected. llg_002 adds the capability for the system to automatically reject proposals that exceed their evaluation deadline, introducing an automated enforcement mechanism distinct from manual review.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Administrator reviews supplier proposal and assigns status
System auto-rejects proposal if evaluation deadline is exceeded

hlg_cfa673e1968aedfc_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Implement an automated inventory replenishment system that enables administrators to configure reorder thresholds, triggers automatic reorder requests based on stock levels, enforces supplier confirmation deadlines, notifies administrators of supplier responses, and updates inventory in real-time upon receipt or confirmation.
hlg_cfa673e1968aedfc_001.rationale: llg_001 enables configuration of reorder thresholds and replenishment rules by administrators; llg_002 ensures real-time inventory updates upon physical receipt; llg_003 triggers automatic reorder requests when stock falls below threshold; llg_004 enforces a 2-working-day confirmation deadline with suppliers; llg_005 notifies administrators of supplier confirmation or rejection with details; llg_006 updates inventory after supplier delivery confirmation, closing the replenishment loop.

System updates inventory in real-time upon product receipt

hlg_d7244e97af16dbad_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Goods-Receiving Staff scans deliveries, assigns items to store locations based on system suggestions, and flags defective items for exclusion with logged reasons.
hlg_d7244e97af16dbad_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for staff to scan deliveries and assign items to store locations; llg_002 adds the capability to flag defective items for exclusion with logging; llg_003 adds the capability for the system to suggest store locations based on inventory needs and product category — which introduces a system-driven decision support function distinct from manual assignment.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Goods-Receiving Staff scans delivery and assigns to store location
Goods-Receiving Staff flags defective items for exclusion

hlg_2860d7ffd5986170_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Order Department Staff manages order completion and delivery status by initiating payment upon full delivery, updating status and adjusting inventory upon partial delivery, and ensuring supplier payment is triggered only when delivery is confirmed complete.
hlg_2860d7ffd5986170_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to confirm order completion and trigger payment to the supplier based on delivery status. llg_002 adds the capability to handle partial delivery by updating the order status and adjusting inventory accordingly. Together, they define a scope that includes both full and partial delivery handling, with payment triggered only upon full delivery, and inventory adjustment for partial delivery — no other capabilities are implied or inferred.

Order Department Staff handles partial delivery and updates order status

hlg_d7309c7d162e5905_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Customer navigates a product catalog to select items, adds them to a shopping cart, selects a payment method, and completes the checkout process to finalize an order.
hlg_d7309c7d162e5905_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the customer to browse products and add selected items to a cart; llg_002 enables the customer to choose a payment method and submit the order for processing. Together, they cover the full lifecycle of a customer initiating and completing a purchase transaction, including cart management and payment finalization.

Customer selects payment method and completes checkout

hlg_ad3295180f971b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Customer-Service Agent creates, assigns, updates, and logs resolution of support tickets.
hlg_ad3295180f971b21_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for the agent to create a support ticket with customer details and assign it to a team member. llg_002 adds the capability for the agent to update the ticket status to reflect resolution and log the solution provided. Together, they define a complete lifecycle of ticket handling by the agent, including creation, assignment, status update, and resolution logging.

Customer-Service Agent updates ticket status and logs resolution

hlg_7e93a5ed6972d209_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Administrator generates and exports predefined operational performance reports covering sales, inventory turnover, and customer support response metrics.
hlg_7e93a5ed6972d209_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to generate sales performance reports over defined periods; llg_002 adds the capability to generate inventory turnover reports by product category; llg_003 adds the capability to generate customer support response time reports including agent performance metrics. All three are distinct, domain-specific reporting functions that must be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve their material differences.
